$comment: Initial client JavaScript per route, gzipped kB. A ratchet: set just above what the route ships, lowered as it improves. See scripts/first-load.mjs. 2026-09-13: /, /privacy, /welcome, /prediction and /casino raised by 12-32 kB for the Watchtower error reporting SDK (@sentry/nextjs). It is loaded statically on purpose: deferring it would move the bytes out of first load but miss the hydration-time crashes that are the most valuable thing it catches. 2026-09-15: raised across the board for the Privy -> Decane migration. The Decane wallet SDK is resident in the signed-in shell, and Privy stays alongside it until the sweep retires, so the floor under every authenticated route moved. Measured, not guessed: each value is the route's actual size plus 20 kB. Before raising it, ~640 kB was taken back out of the shell by deferring the migration sheet (it mounts the whole Privy SDK) and its adapter list (which reaches into four feature barrels) behind next/dynamic - see components/layout/migration-sheet-host.tsx. These numbers come down again when the sweep is retired and Privy leaves the tree. 2026-09-22: /casino/chess/coach-lab receives a 10 kB route-specific margin because Node 24 gzip output crosses the 1900 kB default while Node 25 stays below it. 2026-09-22: the three /casino/chess/learn routes join coach-lab at 1910. They sat 1-4 kB under the 1900 default and the Last Man work moved them 5 kB WITHOUT chess importing any of it: measured against main, /casino itself and /dashboard were unchanged and the chunk count did not move, so this is shared chunks being redistributed rather than new code reaching chess. A route this close to the default crosses it on an unrelated change. 2026-09-23: /perps 1899 -> 1974 and /casino/chess/coach-lab 2206 -> 2227 after merging main (the perps desk and Last Man work); both measured against the previous commit, which built to the same sizes, plus the usual 20 kB. 2026-09-23: main's Mixpanel instrumentation (#547) adds 12-14 kB to every route; it is not one dependency that can be deferred (the SDK is already lazy; the weight is the tracking surface across ~100 call sites plus the failure-reason helper). Re-measured after merging it and set a few kB above what each route ships. 2026-09-24: /auth 1434 -> 1458 and /interests 1431 -> 1454 after merging that instrumentation here: the sign-in screen now reports auth_method_selected and login_failed, which pulls the failure-reason vocabulary into its first load (+4 kB measured), plus the usual 20 kB. 2026-09-25: the three /casino/chess/learn routes measured 2206-2209 after merging staging's Shine (#557): 3 kB of shared-chunk redistribution, as on 09-22, with chess importing none of it. Set at measured plus 20 like the rest. The same merge had put 172 kB on /auth and /interests by statically importing the migration offer into the session providers for Shine's pause; that is deferred through next/dynamic now and both routes are back where they were.
